items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch. Keep private and preview-only. Woot documentation proves API access but not redistribution, caching, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. Current public terms appear inconsistent with the proposed commercial/public data use. Human counsel is required before any rights outreach, public exposure, affiliate use, or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Four legal tasks remain open and none can be closed on the supplied evidence. Existing research confirms the upstream rights blocker and provides partial data-flow and consent artifacts; no task has complete evidence. Next evidence actions: attach the authoritative Woot terms or permission record; produce the repository/configuration data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent behavior and GA4 settings; and inventory logs, vendors, retention, access, incident, and data-subject-request procedures.
